message: The schema components.schemas.Plant (named by its x-fern-type-name) is named "Tree", which is already declared by the schema components.schemas.Tree at #/components/schemas/Tree. Both become Fern types named "Tree" in the same file, so Fern keeps only one of them and silently drops the other; references to the dropped schema point to the one Fern keeps. Rename one of them with x-fern-type-name.
